proof_scope: entrypoint-backed workflow phase regression for project-watchdog receipts

claims.proves: project-watchdog emits explicit workflow_phases for route classification and failure alert policy through its real Python package/tests.
claims.does_not_prove: a live cron tick dispatched, a provider repaired a ticket, or GitHub was mutated.

cases.name: workflow-phases-negative-needs-attention-alert-policy
command:
uv run --project .. python - <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('../scripts').resolve()))
from watchdog import primary
project={'project_id':'p','repo':'o/r','worktree':'/tmp'}
issue={'number':1,'labels':[{'name':'agent-work'}], 'watchdog_action':'ticket_repair'}
r=primary.failure(project, issue, 'boom')
ph={p['id']: p for p in r['workflow_phases']}
assert r['status']=='NEEDS_ATTENTION'
assert ph['ops_discord_alert']['status']=='PENDING'
assert 'COMPLETED does not alert' in ph['ops_discord_alert']['details'][0]
print('NEGATIVE-POLICY-PASS')
PY
